name: Otona no Chikan Densha Club
original_name: 大人の痴漢電車倶楽部
source:
One day, Kantaro Daichi, a hikikomori NEET, obtains the "Adult Molester Train Club Pass", after winning a campaign that only those who paid a large amount to a major site can apply for.

It is said that during the campaign period, those who have this pass can engage in train molestation as much as they want and will not be caught. 

Kantaro begins molesting two people, disciplinary committee member Naruno Hoshiguma and female teacher Ikue Suguri.

[Adapted from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009232.html] DLsite[/url]]
translation:
有一天，蛰居族尼特族大地勘太郎在赢得了一项只有在大型网站上支付大笔费用才能申请的活动后获得了“成人性骚扰者火车俱乐部通行证”。

据说，在竞选期间，持有这张通行证的人可以随心所欲地进行火车猥亵行为，不会被抓到。

勘太郎开始猥亵两个人：风纪委员星熊鸣野和女教师杉生江。
